properties.name: card.security.crypto.pan-hmac-secret
properties.description: HMAC secret key for card PAN hashing.

properties.name: kafka.bootstrap-servers
properties.description: List of Kafka broker addresses used to establish connections to the Kafka cluster.

properties.name: kafka.sasl.username
properties.description: Username used to authenticate with the Kafka cluster using SASL.

properties.name: kafka.sasl.pwd
properties.description: Password used to authenticate with the Kafka cluster using SASL.

properties.name: kafka.ssl.truststore.path
properties.description: Path to the SSL truststore containing the trusted certificates used to verify Kafka brokers.

properties.name: kafka.ssl.truststore.pwd
properties.description: Password used to access the Kafka SSL truststore.

properties.name: kafka.ssl.keystore.path
properties.description: Path to the SSL keystore containing the client certificate and private key used for mutual TLS authentication with Kafka.

properties.name: kafka.ssl.keystore.pwd
properties.description: Password used to access the Kafka SSL keystore.

properties.name: kafka.ssl.key-pwd
properties.description: Password protecting the private key stored in the Kafka SSL keystore.

properties.name: kafka.confluent.avro.schema-registry.url
properties.description: URL of the Confluent Schema Registry used to register and retrieve Avro schemas for Kafka messages.

properties.name: cbs.timezone
properties.description: IANA Timezone ID the CBS will use to coordinate business operations.
